name: Wayfarer Bread & Pastry
notes: All 4 photos are the same letterboard 'Wayfarer Coffee Menu' sign, photographed at different times (prices rise across the set from $3 drip coffee up to $3.50, then $3 again with different tea/latte prices — visits on different dates). It lists only coffee, tea and steamer drinks; no bread or pastry item, price, or food menu appears in any of the 4 photos, so nothing here qualifies as a dish. Treated like a drink-only board: dishes left empty.
